gloss: to slip out; to stand out

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {抜|ぬ}け{出|で}ていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to slip out, to sneak out, to escape
definitions.explanation: To leave a place quietly or without being noticed, or to escape from a situation or confinement.

definitions.gloss: to stand out, to surpass, to excel
definitions.explanation: To be noticeably superior to others in ability, appearance, or quality. To rise above the group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こっそり→こっそり：05890_kossori⟧{抜|ぬ}け{出|で}た。
examples.english: I quietly slipped out of the meeting.
The child snuck out of the house to go play.

examples.japanese: ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}け{出|で}る⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: When I emerged from the tunnel, a beautiful landscape spread before me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{群|ぐん}→群：02790_gun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けて→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.notes: The set phrase {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}く/{抜|ぬ}けて means "to stand head and shoulders above the rest."

⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{今季|こんき}、⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{離|はな}して→引き離す：12584_hikihanasu⟧{抜|ぬ}け{出|で}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: That team has pulled far ahead of the others this season.

notes:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}).
- Negative: {抜|ぬ}け{出|で}ない
- Polite: {抜|ぬ}け{出|で}ます
- Te-form: {抜|ぬ}け{出|で}て
- Past: {抜|ぬ}け{出|で}た

USAGE:
In sense 1, the word implies stealth or an unnoticed departure. In sense 2, it emphasizes being clearly superior. The related compound verb ⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧ is sometimes used interchangeably for sense 1 (escaping), but {抜|ぬ}け{出|で}る is more standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦こっそり→こっそり：05890_kossori⟧{抜|ぬ}け{出|で}る: to sneak out quietly
- ⟦{群|ぐん}→群：02790_gun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けて→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧: standing out from the crowd
- ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}け{出|で}る: to get out of a traffic jam
- ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{抜|ぬ}け{出|で}る: to emerge from a recession
